7.3.5 Required Configuration
The Autosar Diagnostic Extract Template (DEXT) [4] is used for the DM configuration.
By design this format is made as exchange format between the tools in the diagnos-
tic workflow, in different steps data is added. To accommodate the fact that data is
incomplete and refined in a later step, the DEXT [4] allows most of the elements to
be optional and added at a later point in time. However at the point in time, when the
DEXT [4] is used to configure the DM, a certain minimum content is required.
In this chapter a loose list of DEXT [4] constraints is given. The mentioned elements
need to be present so that the DM can be configured. Also the reaction on such missing
